title: Locker Webapp
description: An on-device UI for parcel lockers, located throughout Germany. The lockers are open to multiple providers, which means that various international logistics companies and their systems are integrated. With the UI displayed on the internal screen, customers and couriers can handle automated pickup and drop-off across first- and last-mile delivery. The webapp is designed to run on a variety of hardware platforms of different manufacturers and connecting and processing their sensor data.
tech: Custom copilot harness to generate xState from Figma flows
Planned updates of the UI without interrupting customers
Partial offline support with service worker
Otel-conform tracing and metrics displayed in Grafana
